property.name: logoReference
property.label: Logo Image
property.description: Select the header logo from your CMS workspace using the image picker. Upload the image via Setup > Digital Experiences > CMS Workspaces first, then select it here.

property.name: homeUrl
property.label: Home URL
property.description: URL for the logo link. Defaults to the site root.

property.name: logoHeight
property.label: Logo Height
property.description: Height of the logo in pixels. The header adjusts automatically to fit. Enter a number only (e.g. 48). Leave blank for the default of 48px.

property.name: logoAltText
property.label: Logo Alt Text
property.description: Accessible description of the logo image, read aloud by screen readers. Describe what the logo is and where it leads, e.g. 'Portal - go to home page'.

property.name: backgroundColour
property.label: Background Colour
property.description: Header bar background colour as a hex value (e.g. #000000). Leave blank to inherit from the theme CSS custom property --branded-header-bg.

property.name: focusColour
property.label: Focus Ring Colour
property.description: Focus indicator colour as a hex value (e.g. #ffdd00). Leave blank to inherit from the theme CSS custom property --branded-header-focus.
